# SHAMSI DIGITAL Mali — Official business website and portfolio

Chamsoudine Thienta, also known as Shams and Chamsoudine THIENTA, is an IT consultant, Software Engineer, Data Analyst and trainer based in Bamako, Mali, with more than seven years of experience. He is the founder of SHAMSI Digital Mali, displayed visually as SH☀MSI Digital.

Business identity: SHAMSI DIGITAL is the trade name of Chamsoudine THIENTA's sole proprietorship in Bamako, Mali. RCCM: ML-BKO-01-2026-A-07041. SHAMSI Digital Mali and ShamsiDigital refer to this business. No tax identification number or procurement accreditation is claimed here. KalanSUP source code and project data are private; only public case studies and demonstrations with synthetic data may be shared.

Consulting services include business software and REST APIs, database design, SQL and data cleaning, Power BI dashboards, workflow automation, short information-system audits, specifications, training and user support. Engagements can be delivered in Bamako, across Mali or remotely.

Verified professional context:
- More than 200 students trained in software development, databases, MERISE and computer architecture.
- KalanSUP: an academic-management software product designed and developed with React, Spring Boot and PostgreSQL.
- StoreSup: a MERN inventory and operations application with a public source repository.
- No client institution, deployment or commercial result is claimed unless explicitly stated on the relevant project page.
